- **Story:** As Dana, I want to know where to report a problem and how to report a security issue, so that I can help Phrase improve safely.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given the repository, When Dana looks for help, Then the README links an issues page, a short CONTRIBUTING note (what is welcome, how the mob works in one paragraph) and a SECURITY note with a private way to report
  2. Given the notes, When they are read, Then they contain no personal names or private contact details beyond what the product owner approves
  3. Given the issue templates, When Dana opens an issue, Then it asks for the version, system and the failing command
